# `to_time`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
to_time(str[, format])
```

Parses the `str` expression with the `format` expression to a time.
If `format` is malformed or its application does not result in a well formed time, the function
raises an error. By default, it follows casting rules to a time if the `format` is omitted.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.1.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.1 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT to_time('00:12:00');
```

Result:

```text
00:12:00
```

```sql
SELECT to_time('12.10.05', 'HH.mm.ss');
```

Result:

```text
12:10:05
```
